shots.visual: A trembling finger hovering over a red button on a high-tech detonator, flickering light reflecting on the metal.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 誰過來，我就讓全城陪葬！

shots.visual: Zhao points a handgun directly at Lin Su's head, wind whipping his hair, eyes bloodshot and crazed.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 林素，妳這叛徒，先拿妳祭旗！

shots.visual: Chen Feng walks slowly out of the shadows on the rooftop, his expression cold and devoid of fear.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 趙天豪，你的對手是我。

shots.visual: Extreme wide shot of the skyscraper rooftop at night, flashing red police lights from below illuminating the scene.
Zhao screams hysterically, his face distorted with sweat and rain.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 陳峰！這五年你為什麼沒死在牢裡！

shots.visual: Chen Feng's eyes narrow, showing a brief flash of the hell he endured.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 因為老天要我回來，親手送你下地獄。

shots.visual: Lin Su subtly reaches for a small metallic device on her belt while Zhao is distracted.
Zhao waves the gun wildly, losing his grip on reality.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 趙氏是我的！龍騰也是我的！

shots.visual: Chen Feng takes another step forward, closing the distance.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 你現在除了一條賤命，什麼都沒了。

shots.visual: Zhao's thumb presses down on the button.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 那大家就一起死吧！

shots.visual: Lin Su activates the EMP device, a blue wave of energy ripples through the air.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 做夢！

shots.visual: The lights on the gas device flicker and die. No explosion occurs.
Zhao stares at the dead device in disbelief, clicking the button repeatedly.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 不……不可能！響啊！給我響啊！

shots.visual: Chen Feng lunges forward with explosive speed.
Chen Feng grabs Zhao's wrist and snaps it upward, the gun falling off the roof edge.
Zhao screams in agony as his arm is broken.
Chen Feng delivers a heavy knee to Zhao's stomach, then a punch to his jaw.
Zhao falls to the floor, coughing up blood, crawling backward towards the edge.
Chen Feng stands over Zhao, looking down with absolute disdain.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 這一拳，是替我枉死的兄弟打的。

shots.visual: Chen Feng steps on Zhao's other hand, crushing it.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 這一腳，是為了我這五年受的罪。

shots.visual: Zhao is now completely broken, weeping and begging.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 求求你……陳峰，我把錢都給你……

shots.visual: Chen Feng leans in close to Zhao's ear.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 我不想要你的錢，我只要你生不如死。

shots.visual: Lin Su looks at her watch as police sirens get louder and brighter.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 峰哥，警察上來了。

shots.visual: Chen Feng hands a USB drive to the police commander who just entered the frame.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 這裡是他所有的罪證，一個都跑不掉。

shots.visual: Zhao is dragged away by multiple police officers, shouting incoherently.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 放開我！我是趙天豪！你們不能抓我！

shots.visual: Zhao Meiling is watching the news in her mansion, her face pale as police burst into her room.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 不！這些事與我無關！

shots.visual: Zhao is thrown into a dark, cold iron cell, identical to the one Chen Feng was in.
Zhao grips the bars, his eyes filled with absolute despair and madness.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 放我出去！放我出去啊！

shots.visual: Chen Feng stands outside the bars, looking at Zhao one last time.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 慢慢享受這餘下的五十年吧。

shots.visual: Chen Feng walks out of the prison complex, Lin Su waiting by a black car.
Chen Feng and Lin Su stand on the balcony of the CEO office, overlooking the sunrise.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 趙家徹底倒了，現在全城都在談論你。

shots.visual: Chen Feng gazes at the horizon, the darkness in his eyes slowly replaced by a cold light.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 這不是結束。

shots.visual: Chen Feng turns to Lin Su, a faint, dangerous smile on his lips.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 是新秩序的開始。

shots.visual: The camera pulls back quickly, showing Chen Feng standing at the very peak of the city.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 血債已償，王座易主。

shots.visual: Close-up of Chen Feng's eyes. They are sharp, cold, and dominant. Freeze frame.
